subject: Jonathan Malerba Interview
overview: Host Steve Bertorelli interviews UMass Boston student Jonathan Malerba about his experience overcoming neurofibromatosis and his work as a local sports photographer.

items.title: Host Introduction and Background
items.summary: Host Steve Bertorelli introduces guest Jonathan Malerba, a former Medford High School student currently attending UMass Boston.

items.title: Boston 25 News Feature
items.summary: The show plays a news broadcast segment profiling Jonathan Malerba's positivity and impact on the Medford High School track team while battling neurofibromatosis.

items.title: Discussion of Medical Diagnosis
items.summary: Malerba explains his diagnosis of neurofibromatosis, a genetic disorder causing tumor growth, and details the leg surgeries he underwent during high school.

items.title: Sports Photography Showcase
items.summary: Malerba discusses how he began taking sports photographs to stay involved with athletics while recovering from surgery and presents a selection of his high school and college sports photos.
